content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: on sales invoice:new, a visible validation error appears about 250-370 ms after the first edit to Payment Due Date in all three sessions, and each Save click then raises another visible error. Users return to Payment Due Date after the last error, edit it again, and leave the screen without a further Save click (S4f6ead43 navigates to customer:list; Se8131012 navigates after a Back click; Sab8e6b94 shows no save after the last edit within its window).", "fix": "Fix: On the sales invoice:new form, render the Payment Due Date validation message inline beneath that input with the specific rule it breaks (for example, the date must be on or after the invoice date), clear that message as soon as the value changes, and make the Save error summary name the offending field so it links back to Payment Due Date.", "cited_event_ids": ["343", "351:a348", "599", "600:e623", "661", "663:e689", "667", "682:709", "app:17", "345", "353:a358", "600", "601:e632", "662", "664:e703", "669", "app:17", "347", "354:a372", "606", "607:e671", "668", "670:e735", "675"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The visible error events carry no label or field name, so it is not confirmed that the error targets Payment Due Date rather than another field such as Customer.", "The error message text and the validation rule are not in the events.", "Sab8e6b94's window ends at 26064 ms before any navigation, so its abandonment is taken from the insight facts, not from the events.", "Whether users intended to save later cannot be determined from the events."]}
